source.title: Data Tables for Lorentz and CPT Violation
source.authors: V. Alan Kostelecky and Neil Russell
locators: PDF pp.1-2: scope, update date, and summary-table construction
PDF pp.2-3: summary limits are conservative 2-sigma sensitivities and each entry assumes one coefficient is nonzero
PDF pp.3-4: data-table columns, quoted errors, context, and source citations
PDF pp.29 onward: data tables D6-D57 and the allowlisted matter/photon sectors

observable_scope.allowed_representation: A finite allowlist of directly measured or bounded table rows with their coefficient combination, quoted result, context and cited source.
observable_scope.summary_table_semantics: Summary values are conservative 2-sigma order-of-magnitude sensitivities and are not a joint measurement vector.
observable_scope.data_table_semantics: Data-table rows preserve reported statistical/systematic errors and source context; correlated combinations remain explicitly non-independent unless a source likelihood is supplied.

uncertainty_contract.allowed_rule: Feasibility intersection only for the explicitly allowlisted rows; retain quoted uncertainty labels and do not synthesize a joint Gaussian.
uncertainty_contract.forbidden_rule: Do not multiply rows, summary sensitivities, or correlated derived combinations as independent observations.
uncertainty_contract.independence: Each experiment/source lineage remains separate; one source citation or coefficient combination does not become an independent replicate.

theory_conversion.target: Candidate Lorentz-violation coefficients mapped to the allowlisted SME rows with sector, operator dimension, frame and direction fixed.

assumptions: The retrieved bytes are the January 2026 arXiv v19 edition and the SHA-256 identifies this source version.
The standard Sun-centered frame and the source's coefficient conventions are retained.
Single-coefficient summary sensitivities are descriptive constraints, not a joint likelihood.
The anchor is calibration input and does not itself select a microscopic candidate or dynamics.
missing_assumptions: The explicit finite allowlist of rows to be used in a candidate comparison.
Measurement-level likelihood/covariance for any row that is to receive a score rather than a feasibility check.
A complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map from each admitted microscopic candidate.
A fixed scorer, acceptance rule, and nuisance/error budget.
acceptance_condition: This packet may support only candidate-neutral feasibility checks after the row allowlist and theory conversion are frozen; scoring requires source likelihood/covariance and a complete map.
falsifier: If a candidate violates an applicable allowlisted bound after declared theory uncertainty, it fails that finite feasibility check; no global Lorentz or microscopic conclusion follows.
non_claims: The tables do not prove exact Lorentz invariance or a causal cone.
They do not identify TECT dynamics, a physical vacuum, or a unique microscopic action.
They do not supply a joint Gaussian, independent observations, or a continuum constraint by themselves.
They do not establish Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, empirical predictivity, or a mass gap.
next_action: Freeze the finite row allowlist and source-lineage crosswalk, then run the existing schema/lineage validator. Keep scoring and candidate selection stopped until likelihood/covariance and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs are admitted.
